policy: Qualification is separate from implementation. Only independently reviewed evidence can support a qualified status. This ledger is not itself proof of a control or authorization to publish.

gates.requirement: Exact candidate regression and independent holdout tests; demonstrate detection at the runtime boundary.
Trusted address handling, dual-stack enforcement, canonicalization and verified deployment evidence.
Versioned OWASP coverage matrix including application-owned controls, reviewed tests, and residual risk closure; WAF alone cannot establish full coverage.
Approved route coverage, concurrency and multi-region consistency, bounded recovery and load evidence.
Reviewed structured contracts and application parameterization/output encoding; representative independent prevention and benign tests.
Versioned route inventory and reviewed schemas; negative/positive regression and deployment evidence.
Bounded parsing, streaming, malformed input handling, content-type coverage and runtime latency evidence.
Authorized privacy-preserving signals, verified trust boundary and tested false-positive, expiry and appeal behavior.
Approved signed feed, persisted atomic sequence/manifest, scheduled ingestion, expiry and advisory-only runtime integration evidence.
Approved containment/expiry/recovery and rollback tests, including legitimate shared-address traffic, with production verification.
Isolated decoy verification, no real credentials, no unauthorized egress, reviewed production evidence.
Integrity, retention, access and deletion verification with redacted audit evidence.
Delivery, deduplication, authentication, rate bounds and recovery evidence on approved notification channels.
Approved bounded load test in isolated representative environment, runtime P95 <5 ms with remote state separately measured, no production disruption.
Independent human reviewer, defined scope and exact candidate/deployment, findings and remediation/retest; zero known unfixed critical findings.
Actual independent provider deployment, parity, distributed state/evidence and rollback verification; portable runtime CI alone is insufficient.
At least 30 days of independent end-to-end SLI observations with missing samples accounted for; >=99.99% and reviewed measurement scope.
